2608.20338.title: ConceptGuard: Benchmarking Context-Sensitive Unlearning in Large Language Models
2608.20338.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly require selective removal of harmful or sensitive knowledge, called unlearning, yet existing methods and benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability completely. Current approaches rely on disjoint forget and retain sets composed of independent facts, and measure success using simple and direct factual recall. This framing fails to capture a key requirement of unlearning, namely the ability to eliminate harmful behaviors while preserving benign and beneficial knowledge. We argue that effective unlearning must operate at the level of concepts, ensuring complete removal of unsafe applications while maintaining their correct and useful usage, thereby achieving conceptually meaningful and complete unlearning. To better evaluate unlearning techniques from such a practical viewpoint, we introduce the notion of dual-use concepts: concepts that can be used in both harmful and benign contexts. Building on these concepts, we construct a benchmark called ConceptGuard where forget and retain sets are explicitly complementary in concept usage. Our benchmark uniquely enables unlearning to be explored and gauged at the level of concepts, instead of sparse facts, and evaluation is intent-sensitive with the goal of maximizing contextual separation to promote safer behavior. We demonstrate that current unlearning techniques perform poorly under this setting, showing weak contextual separation alongside poor performance in ROUGE and concept-level metrics. Our results reveal strong forgetting-utility trade-offs, limited gains in contextual sensitivity, and poor consistency in concept-level control across methods, and provide ideas for unlearning approaches that better align with real-world safety requirements. Our dataset is publicly available.
2608.20338.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越需要選擇性地移除有害或敏感的知識，這稱為「遺忘」，然而現有的方法和基準無法完全評估這一能力。當前的方法依賴於由獨立事實組成的分離的忘記和保留集合，並使用簡單直接的事實回憶來衡量成功。這種框架未能捕捉到遺忘的一個關鍵要求，即在保留良性和有益知識的同時消除有害行為的能力。我們認為，有效的遺忘必須在概念層面運作，確保完全去除不安全的應用，同時保持其正確和有用的使用，從而實現概念上有意義且完整的遺忘。為了從這種實際的角度更好地評估遺忘技術，我們引入了雙重用途概念的概念：可以在有害和良性上下文中使用的概念。基於這些概念，我們構建了一個名為 ConceptGuard 的基準，其中忘記和保留集合在概念使用上是明確互補的。我們的基準獨特地使遺忘能夠在概念層面上進行探索和評估，而不是稀疏的事實，並且評估是意圖敏感的，目標是最大化上下文分離以促進更安全的行為。我們展示了當前的遺忘技術在這種設置下表現不佳，顯示出薄弱的上下文分離，以及在 ROUGE 和概念層面指標上的表現不佳。我們的結果揭示了強烈的遺忘-效用權衡、有限的上下文敏感性增益，以及方法之間在概念層面控制上的一致性差，並提供了更好地符合現實世界安全需求的遺忘方法的想法。我們的數據集是公開可用的。
